title: pm: the sweep's favourable answer covers the raw status read only; PD14 names the arm's rows
body:
Fixes #34107

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9DhBTDykFH6f9bchWYkPpus)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：补上 #33975 第 5 轮合同复审的两处修复：AGENTS.md PD14 的 CODEOWNERS 一句改为“除低风险臂的行外”（根 ADR 树已随 #33975 离开 CODEOWNERS）；合并后巡检的“有利答案”只给 `diff-tree --raw` 状态读，ADR 补丁读失败时如实记“未测到”。
- 为什么改：#33975 已在队列中合并，这两处来不及推上去（卡 #34107）；PD14 那句原文在 #33975 之后已不成立，巡检会把一次没读到的补丁当成测到的 Tier H。
- 风险与回滚：只改一句规则文和一个纯函数的判定条件，回滚即 revert。删掉 `/docs/adr/` 的 CODEOWNERS 行后，根 ADR 的 PR 若以 ready 状态打开（或手动转 ready），GitHub 不再自动发 code-owner 审查请求；对“只增注释以外”的 ADR 改动，裁决改由队列守卫（无 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 批准即拒）和中继逐 PR 请求两位批准人来守住。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` 的 `favourableArmGitRead`，以及 AGENTS.md 第 306 行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test`，看 `#33539-S7-…` 一行。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 动 AGENTS.md（Tier H），保持 draft，请 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 审批。

## What changes

- **AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14** (contract review 6898480793, M4): "CODEOWNERS routes every Tier H surface but the low-risk catalogs" becomes "… but the low-risk arm's rows". Since #33975 the root ADR tree is an arm row with no CODEOWNERS line, and an ADR tree is not a catalog. One word swap, same line, 118 bytes; AGENTS.md stays at 1050 lines.
- **`favourableArmGitRead`** (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, S7): it now answers only the `diff-tree --raw` status read (argv carries `--raw`, not `-p`). The ADR leg's `diff-tree -p` patch read has no favourable answer, so in the post-merge sweep an ADR landing whose patch read alone fails stays NOT MEASURED (sweep incomplete) instead of reading Tier H on a status listing handed back as a patch. The queue, the relay and `--pr` were never affected: there an unread ADR diff already reads H.
- One self-test row pins it in the sweep battery: `⛔ #33539-S7-an-ADR-landing-whose-patch-read-alone-fails-stays-NOT-MEASURED-only-the-raw-read-has-a-favourable-answer`. The existing N-a row that called `favourableArmGitRead(['diff-tree', LANDED], …)` now passes `--raw` (a forced test edit: the bare argv no longer has a favourable answer).

## Why

PR #33975 merged from the queue at `b60484d4` before these round-5 fixes could be pushed. Card #34107 carries them.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test`: 863 assertions, exit 0.
- Ablation: answering the patch read too (the pre-fix condition) reds exactly the new S7 row; restored, green.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` green; AGENTS.md 1050 lines.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this head: 38 derived, 38 run, all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`; `check:adr-anchors` and the 10 importer self-tests exit 0.

### Not carried

- The #33975 round-5 nit N9 (rewrapping and wording the CODEOWNERS header note) is not in this card's file surface, so `.github/CODEOWNERS` is untouched here.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` not run here — no package source changed; CI's ESLint leg reads it)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (except the required 维护者速读 block)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
